_comment: Draft mapping from clarity.by (WordPress + WooCommerce) product_cat
slugs to our Products fields, built from what GET /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat
actually returns today. Edit this file, then re-run the script — it is
read fresh on every run, nothing is hardcoded in migrate-wp.ts.
- subtitle feeds Products.subtitle (used for napolniteli's two children,
which aren't an animal or a type, just how the litter is textured).
- skip: true means the category itself carries no product data (e.g. the
site's catch-all 'Все товары') — products keep any OTHER category they
have; a product left with zero usable categories after skipping is
reported as skipped, not migrated with guessed values.
UNRESOLVED: 'korrektory' (Корректоры поведения, id 93, 2 products) has no
care/home). Left unmapped on purpose — decide: add a 6th categoryType, or
fold it into an existing one (closest is probably 'care'), or exclude
those 2 products. Whatever you pick, edit this file accordingly; until
then the script reports every product that's ONLY in this category as
